title: The Three Rains and the Cycle Through Degrees
description: T50 describes three distinct conduits by which influx comes down and life is drawn back up: through the body where the seeds of life were hidden in the fallen forms; through the soul's perceptions, which grow in the natural like trees rooted in earth; and through the affections, the natural body of love. The third also carries downward what abounds in disordered affection — craving, wrath, malice — through which creatures of flesh entangle themselves under the gaze of the higher. T51 explains how the cycle of regeneration moves through the discrete degrees of the rational without tearing them or mingling with what they hold. Each degree remains itself, undisturbed in its proper boundary, while the soul is carried through it again and again — for what is spiritual is not torn by what moves through it.
